text: Hosted the quartet here after a Friday night set and it was perfect. The roast chicken is honest, the room is warm, and they let us linger over a long late dinner. My new spot for band celebrations.
Strip steak cooked exactly right and the cornbread alone is worth the trip. Service never rushed us. Easily one of the best dinners in the Crossroads.
Took the whole band here after a Spotlight Room gig. The doro wat and the veggie combo had everyone reaching across the table. Generous, comforting, and easy to share. We'll be back.
The fondue is a fun way to end a long week and the schnitzel is properly done. A touch pricey and a little loud up front, but a cozy choice when you want something different.
My go-to for a quick weeknight dinner with the kids between rehearsals. The burger and loaded fries never miss and we're in and out fast. Friendly, reliable, close to home.
Solid neighborhood spot for lunch. Good portions and quick service. The fries are the standout.
There's no better room in Kansas City to hear live jazz, and the kitchen has stepped up too. We play here often and the crowd really listens. Get there early for a table near the stage.
Intimate listening room with a great piano and honest sound. Played a late set here and the audience energy was wonderful. A real gem on the south end of the Crossroads.
